zh: 或者给我们一个 ID，并高亮职位描述里非常好的一个部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can get really creative with your render tools to be able to give some extra character that the model can inject into those so that you've got a much better experience for the user.
zh: 所以你可以让你的渲染工具变得非常有创造力，给模型提供一些可以注入其中的额外个性，这样你就能给用户带来好得多的体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the key takeaways, when building MCP apps, you want to focus on the data before you focus on the UI, which sounds opposite of how we were thinking about it, of like, hey, there's all these MCP apps.
zh: 所以关键要点是，在构建 MCP 应用时，你要在关注 UI 之前先关注数据，这听起来和我们之前的思考方式相反，比如，嘿，有这么多 MCP 应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's how I put UI into ChatGPT.
zh: 它是我把 UI 放进 ChatGPT 的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think if you want to really have a good MCP apps experience, you need to...
zh: 我认为如果你想真正拥有一个好的 MCP 应用体验，你需要……

speaker: Unknown
en: You look at and see what data do I want to give to the model, what data do I want it to be able to do, and then rendering is a side effect of that, or it's a result of the model exploring the data.
zh: 你去看看，我想给模型什么数据，我想让它能对这些数据做什么，然后渲染就是它的一个副作用，或者说是模型探索数据的一个结果。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I think small composable tools, right, so basically, you know,
zh: 然后我认为是小的可组合工具，对吧，基本上，你知道，

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe there's two or three different ways you can search for jobs.
zh: 也许有两三种不同的方式可以搜索职位。

speaker: Unknown
en: We can build two or three different search tools, and then there's one render tool.
zh: 我们可以构建两三个不同的搜索工具，然后有一个渲染工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or maybe there's two render tools.
zh: 或者也许有两个渲染工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's one that's render a list of jobs, one that's highlight one particular job.
zh: 一个是渲染一组职位，一个是高亮某个特定职位。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can build a bunch of much smaller tools.
zh: 所以你可以构建一堆小得多的工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: The descriptions can be fairly simple so you don't overload the model, but it gives the model flexibility about how it wants to explore the data and how it wants to render the tools.
zh: 描述可以相当简单，这样就不会让模型过载，但它给了模型灵活性，让它可以按自己想的方式去探索数据、按自己想的方式去渲染这些工具。
